literal: Like women of singleness indeed, greatness too exists if oneself having guarded oneself conducts oneself.
translation: Just like women of single-minded devotion, true greatness exists only if one guards oneself and behaves with discipline.
modern: கற்புடைய பெண்களைப் போல, ஒருவன் தன்னைத் தானே காத்துக்கொண்டு நல்வழியில் நடந்தால் மட்டுமே அவனுக்குப் பெருமை நிலைத்திருக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet compares the preservation of greatness to the single-minded devotion of chaste women. The word 'ஒருமை' (singleness) here refers to unwavering moral focus or chastity. Just as such women protect their own virtue, a person must actively guard their own character to maintain their greatness. Greatness is not a permanent given; it exists only as long as one conducts oneself with disciplined self-restraint.
